findings.summary: When options.encoding is set, the Accept-Encoding header is no longer checked, so responses may be compressed with an encoding (e.g. gzip) the client never accepted and can't decode.

judge.reason: Same defect: configured encoding short-circuits the Accept-Encoding check, so clients get an encoding they didn't accept.
